class.name: VECSCommandBuffer
class.brief_description: A deferred queue for structural changes (add/remove component, destroy entity).
class.description:
[b]VECSCommandBuffer[/b] batches structural changes so they can be applied at a safe point. Multiple changes to the same entity collapse into a single archetype transition, and events are dispatched per net change (e.g. [code][add A, remove A][/code] nets to "no A").
Structural changes are forbidden inside [method VECSWorld.each] and C++ iterations; queue them here and call [method flush] once afterwards. All handles returned by [method VECSWorld.commands] share the same world-level buffer, so [method flush] applies everything queued by every handle.

method.name: add_component
method.description: Queues adding the component [param type_name] (initialized from [param fields]) to [param entity] at the next [method flush].

method.name: add_entity
method.description: Queues creating [param entity] at the next [method flush]. Pass a preassigned handle (e.g. from the network layer) whose id should exist by then.

method.name: flush
method.description: Applies every queued operation now and clears the buffer. Safe to call from anywhere outside an iteration. Flushing inside an iteration is rejected.

method.name: remove_component
method.description: Queues removing the component [param type_name] from [param entity] at the next [method flush].

method.name: remove_entity
method.description: Queues destroying [param entity] at the next [method flush].

method.name: size
method.description: Returns the number of operations currently queued in the shared world buffer.
